body:
New internal/qi/lexer (Lex/Token/Kind) per QI_NORTHSTAR.md's phased plan. Parens/brackets, deliberately permissive bare symbols (no restricted charset), decimal int literals range-checked to 0-3 (LO's own base4 states), double-quoted strings (no escapes, matching LO's own LITERAL rule), and ; line comments. 11 new tests including QI_NORTHSTAR.md's own worked example (let [x 1] (+4 x x)). Real, honest scope: lexer only -- Phase 2b (parser + name-resolution lowering to internal/parser's existing AST, qi's own real named-variables value-add) not attempted yet. GOWORK=off go build/vet/test ./... clean. commit de8b918.

⚓ ☃
title: qi Phase 2a: real lexer for the ASCII surface syntax
